questions.stem: Among the following options, the first monoclonal antibody to be approved for the treatment of breast cancer is?
questions.solutionHtml:
Trastuzumab

Trastuzumab is used to treat certain types of breast or stomach cancer, sometimes combined with other cancer medicines. trastuzumab is sometimes used when the cancer has spread to other parts of the body (metastatic).



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 930

questions.stem: Sipuleucel-T is used in the treatment of which of the following condition?
questions.solutionHtml:
Prostate cancer

Sipuleucel-T:

  • is a cell-based approach designed to induce an immune response against PAP, which is expressed in most prostate cancers


Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition, Chapter 67, Page No. 1224.

questions.stem: Treatment of choice for Glioblastoma multiforme is?
questions.solutionHtml:
Temozolomide

Temozolomide is used in the treatment of specific types of cancer of the brain. It is used to treat brain tumors if they return or get worse after standard treatment. It may be also used to treat other conditions, as determined by the doctor.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 920

questions.stem: Among the following options, the Treatment of choice for Hepatocellular carcinoma is?
questions.solutionHtml:
Sorafenib

Hepatocellular carcinoma

  • Single-agent chemotherapy: Sorafenib
  • other drugs:Doxorubicin, regorafenib


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 931

questions.stem: Among the following options, ‘Hand Foot’ syndrome can be caused by?
questions.solutionHtml:
Capecitabine

Capecitabine, is used in the treatment of cancer of the breast, colon, and rectum. It may be also used to treat other conditions, as determined by the doctor.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 923

questions.stem: ATRA is useful in the treatment of which of the following type of AML?
questions.solutionHtml:
Promyelocytic leukemia

Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) is a cancer of the myeloid line of blood cells, characterized by the rapid growth of abnormal cells that build up in the bone marrow and blood and interfere with normal blood cell production. Symptoms may include feeling tired, shortness of breath, easy bruising, and bleeding.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 928

questions.stem: Leucovorin is used as Rescue therapy for patients who are on one of the following drug therapies:
questions.solutionHtml:
Methotrexate

Methotrexate, is a medicine used to treat rheumatoid arthritis where it can prevent further joint damage. It is also used to treat severe forms of a skin disease called psoriasis by killing cells in the skin which are growing too quickly and to treat tumors in a range of cancers.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 972

questions.stem: Which of the following is the most common adverse reaction associated with cyclosporine therapy?
questions.solutionHtml:
Nephrotoxicity and infection risk
  • Nephrotoxicity; occurs in about 8 of 10 patients receiving cyclosporine. It is typically dose-dependent and, particularly in renal transplant patients, could be due to either the drug (too much) or rejection. Infection occurs about as often as renal dysfunction.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 939,940
